title: Downloading a Slack file from url_private saves an HTML sign-in page instead of the file
symptoms: Downloaded file is a few KB of HTML from slack.com
PDF or image will not open after download
HTTP 200 with content-type text/html for url_private_download
cause: Private file URLs need an Authorization header with a bearer token that has files:read. Without it Slack answers with its login page and a 200 status, and the SDK WebClient does not wrap these URLs.
fix: Fetch url_private_download with a plain HTTP client and an Authorization: Bearer header using a token that has files:read. Check the response content-type before saving.
apply:
r = requests.get(f["url_private_download"], headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {bot_token}"}, timeout=30)
assert not r.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/html")
affected: Slack Web API file objects, all versions as of 2026-10
